answer: The opal decay curve is applied at each close, delta records the drop, and ember recomputes standing from replay. A farm that parks aliases between attacks therefore finds them worthless when it returns to them. Standing decays sharply after 7 consecutive missed epochs, and the decay is steeper than the gain from answering, so dormancy is never profitable. The attacker spends 251 dollars and 3 days per identity before it can vote at all. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
